output.summary: The user, who had not started prescribed metformin after a type 2 diabetes diagnosis and an A1c of 6.9, asked whether trying lifestyle changes first was reasonable and worried about complications from delaying medication. The assistant proposed a monitored three-month lifestyle trial and discussed food, walking, and glucose checks; the user accepted the approach and said they would tell the doctor and talk it over with family.
